thread:
maria: Heads-up — Acme's prod is seeing a 503 spike starting ~11:02 UTC. Customer reports timeouts + intermittent 500s when calling /v1/generate.

maria: Error rate hit p95 12% for their org key, affects streaming endpoints. CS opened a ticket and asked for a quick mitigation. :grimacing:

devon_oncall: I'm on it. Any immediate correlation with deploys or autoscale events?

deploy-bot: deployment event: svc/infer-runner rolled 3 -> 1 at 11:01:54 UTC (autoscaler scale-down)

samir: That scale-down sounds suspicious. Can we see worker logs and OOM events?

jess_runtime: Pulling logs now. Early look: multiple runners reported SIGSEGV in attention kernel then container restarted. Also saw cgroup OOM kill for one pod. snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T11:02:14Z] runtime: signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code=1 pc=0x7f8cabc12345
#0  0x7f8cabc12345 in attention_kernel(...)
#1  0x7f8c9ffb234 in forward_layer
```

alex_sre: Do we have nvml/gpu logs around that time (driver resets, memory errors)?

jess_runtime: NVML shows one GPU reset on node gpu-27 at 11:02:13, mem used jumped from ~78% -> 100% in a few ms. Also fragmentation reported: "free 0 bytes, largest free chunk 0" in our allocator logs.

samir: Customer profile: heavy streaming with long contexts (~12k tokens) and toolcall enabled. They also hit a sudden burst of concurrent requests at 11:01. Looks like dynamic batch resize during scale down pushed batch sizes up -> memory ballooning.

devon_oncall: Repro attempt on staging with a similar workload? Steps?

jess_runtime: Repro steps I'm running: 
1) start 8 concurrent streaming clients with 12k context each
2) trigger a scale-down (kubectl scale deployment --replicas=1) while streams active
3) run until 503s appear (~a few secs)

maria: CS says customers see timeouts then immediate reconnects, so UX is retries then success sometimes. Billing impact: a few hundred failed requests; CS wants token-level logs for affected org keys.

alex_sre: Short-term mitigation: add routing rule to drain new requests away from affected pool, route Acme to warmpool/dedicated for next hour; increase replica min to avoid scale-down during heavy streams. I can patch autoscaler policy temporarily.

samir: Longer-term: need to harden batch-resize path and ensure KV-prefetch + large-context combos can't trigger memory ballooning. Add guardrail: refuse batch resize if predicted memory > 90% of gpu capacity. Also capture full core dump on SIGSEGV.

devon_oncall: I'm doing an emergency rollback of the autoscaler tweak now (+set min_replicas=2 for infer-runner for 30m). Will update in 2m.

cs_lead: Maria — tell Acme we have a mitigation in flight and will follow up with a postmortem and token-level logs. Offer credits for failed calls, pending engineering RCA.

jess_runtime: Action items: (1) Alex apply routing change and hold scale-down (2) Samir collect cores + enable jumbo debug logs for afflicted nodes (3) Devon monitor error rate and confirm reduction (4) Followup ticket ENG-RUNTIME-1428 to add memory guardrail and better batch accounting.

devon_oncall: Update: after setting min_replicas=2 and routing Acme to warmpool, their error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% in 90s. Keeping monitors on for 15min.

maria: Noted. I'll reply to the customer with the temporary mitigation and ETA for full fix. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

samir: Please attach the core + allocator logs to ENG-RUNTIME-1428 when ready. Put repro harness under /infra/repro/harnesses/large_stream_resize so SRE can run.

alex_sre: Will also add a circuit-breaker on batch resize in the runtime: fail-open to smaller batch when memory pressure high. Adding design doc to the ticket.

maria: Closing loop with CS: told them we mitigated, monitoring, will share postmortem. If the error reappears I'll reopen thread.
